_doc: FROZEN pre-registration for the class-conditional-exits overnight-kitchen candidate lane. Written and locked BEFORE any candidate cell was computed -- knob values below are chosen from the STRUCTURE of the population's exit-reason/stop-mode mechanics (per class, which stop each class actually reads) and from precedent step sizes already used in trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json, never from PnL-by-bucket. No knob/band/gate/grid change is permitted after this file is written; a change requires a NEW dated pre-reg, never an edit to this one.
task_framing: The global trail-width A/B (trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json) tested ONE exit shape applied uniformly to the whole blended real-fills population and returned CONTROL_HOLDS on every candidate (n=113, 6 candidates, 0/6 shipped). This is a DIFFERENT, legitimately new question: do the WINNER/LOSER CLASSES the engine already produces internally (trendline-only-tier vs confluence-tier trades; day-regime around the trade) want a DIFFERENT exit shape than the one blended shape currently applied to everyone? If per-class beats global control on the standing 4-gate bar, that is real; if not, CONTROL_HOLDS again and is reported as such, honestly.

population.source: analysis/recommendations/engine-fullhist-replay-2026-07-23.json (`trades` array) -- the CURRENT LIVE core-Safe engine's full-history replay, RIDE_THE_RIBBON family only, 190 trades / 141 trading days / 2025-01-02..2026-07-22. Reused verbatim, NOT re-run (no new run_backtest call).
population.anchor_population_signature: sorted list of {date, symbol, entry_time_et, qty} for all 190 trades -- hash-locked so a drifted source file aborts the run rather than silently reusing a stale hash.
fidelity_stack: ENTRY: backtest/lib/orchestrator.py#run_backtest(**SAFE_BASE_LIVE) -- reused verbatim from the committed replay JSON, not re-run.

EXIT: backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.py#walk_exit_manager driving the REAL automation/state/fleet/exit_manager.py#plan_exit_actions core, re-walked fresh in THIS study under each candidate exit_shape (the whole point of the study). Ribbon-flip-back fidelity preserved: this study rebuilds the SAME continuous-RTH ribbon lookup + backward merge_asof onto each trade's own option-contract bars that engine_fullhist_replay.py#build_ribbon_lookup/ribbon_tick_df_for used, so CONTROL replayed here reproduces the source replay's per-trade dollar_pnl byte-for-byte (verified as a preflight check before any candidate is scored).

DOLLARS: real OPRA fills only (backtest/data/options/{symbol}.csv via lib.option_pricing_real.load_contract_bars) -- the source replay already excluded any entry whose contract CSV wasn't cached (16 excluded upstream); zero BS-synthetic in this population.

trigger_level: reused verbatim from the source replay's own per-trade field (t.rejection_level at entry) -- not re-recovered via a backward-scan heuristic. Mechanically confirmed (this study, preflight): ALL 124 TRENDLINE-tier trades have trigger_level=None (0% recoverable -- trendline_rejection alone never resolves a discrete S/R level) and ALL 66 non-TRENDLINE trades (SUPER+ELITE+LEVEL) have trigger_level present (100%). This is a real, structural, causal-at-entry fact (which tier a signal earns is known the instant it fires, from which triggers co-occur), not a study artifact -- it is WHY exit_manager.ExitState.from_entry resolves TRENDLINE trades to stop_mode='premium' (reads premium_stop_pct) and every other tier to stop_mode='structure' (reads catastrophe_stop_pct as its pre-TP1 floor) with zero overlap. This mechanical fact is the causal handle this study's knobs are built on.

held_out.source: analysis/edge-matrix/day-inventory-2026-07-23.json `heldout_days` (96 dates, last ceil(25%) of the 386 opra_days by date, per that file's own `method.heldout` field) -- SACRED, read exactly once per cell, only for gate 4, never during grid design.

CLASS_TIER (causal at entry, PRIMARY, ga.definition: tier field already on each trade record (elite_bear_level_reject_gate_ab.classify_tier, computed from which triggers co-fired at signal time -- known the instant the setup fires, before any exit decision). TRENDLINE = single-trigger (trendline_rejection alone). STRUCTURE = SUPER+ELITE+LEVEL pooled (any trade carrying a recoverable trigger_level, i.e. a real S/R level was touched).
CLASS_TIER (causal at entry, PRIMARY, ga.causality: Fully causal -- the tier is fixed at the moment the setup fires, before entry, before any exit-shape decision is made.

CLASS_DAYLAG (causal at entry, SECONDARY.definition: The PRIOR covered trading day's day_type (analysis/edge-matrix/day-inventory-2026-07-23.json, ATR20-based trend/range/chop classification) -- looked up as the entry immediately preceding this trade's date in the inventory's own chronologically-sorted `days` list. PRIOR_CHOP = yesterday classified chop. PRIOR_OTHER = yesterday classified trend/range/unclassified, or no prior row available (1 date, 2026-06-15, the disclosed SPY-bar-gap day -- falls back to PRIOR_OTHER/control, never fabricated).
CLASS_DAYLAG (causal at entry, SECONDARY.causality: Fully causal -- yesterday's classification is complete and known before today's market open, unlike the day-inventory's SAME-day day_type (which needs that day's own full RTH range/body_frac and is therefore NOT known until EOD). This is a genuinely deployable, lagged proxy for the anatomy doc's day-archetype finding, not the identical signal.

CLASS_DAYSAME (NON-CAUSAL, DIAGNOSTIC ON.definition: The SAME trading day's day_type from day-inventory.json, used ONLY to check whether the causal CLASS_DAYLAG proxy above is leaving signal on the table (an oracle upper-bound check), never proposed as a deployable policy.
CLASS_DAYSAME (NON-CAUSAL, DIAGNOSTIC ON.disclosure: Requires the day's own realized RTH range and candle body fraction, both of which are only complete at end-of-day -- a same-day day_type gate cannot be evaluated at any actual entry time this morning. Cells built on this dimension are reported honestly (per the standing OP-33 visibility rule) but are NOT eligible for a SHIP verdict regardless of how the 4 gates read; they exist to answer one question only -- 'is the causal proxy failing to find something a perfect-hindsight classifier would have found' -- and that answer is disclosed as a diagnostic finding, never a candidate.

grid.control_shape: strategies.RIBBON_RIDE.exit.to_dict() unchanged in every field for any trade not matched by a cell's class rule.

knobs.name: premium_stop_pct
knobs.mechanism: The pre-TP1 hard stop read ONLY when ExitState resolves stop_mode='premium' -- exclusively TRENDLINE-tier trades in this population (see population.fidelity_stack). 71% of TRENDLINE trades (88/124) exit via this exact stop; it is the single largest loss driver in the whole engine (anatomy doc: premium_stop 92 tr matrix-wide, -$8,584). -0.12/-0.30 are +/-0.08 steps from control, the same step-size family trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json's TRAIL-20/25/30 axis already used (+0.05 steps off a 0.15 base) scaled to this knob's larger control magnitude; never touches a STRUCTURE-tier trade (that class reads catastrophe_stop_pct instead, a structurally disjoint field).

knobs.name: trail_pct
knobs.mechanism: The post-TP1 chandelier trail width (HWM*(1-trail_pct) floor) -- read by ANY trade that reaches the runner stage, regardless of tier (14/124 TRENDLINE and 19/66 STRUCTURE trades close via runner_stop/trail in the source replay). 0.10 is the same value TRENDLINE's own exit distribution rarely reaches, testing 'lock in wins faster'; 0.25 replays the SAME upper value trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json's TRAIL-30 already tested on the real-fills population (that cell's own aggregate delta was +$168 but failed gate 2, CONTROL_HOLDS -- cited, not reused, since this is a different, smaller, non-overlapping population).

cells.note: == pure CONTROL, sanity check only (delta must be exactly $0.00)

cells.applies_to: trades whose PRIOR covered day was chop
trades whose PRIOR covered day was NOT chop
trades entered on a day whose OWN (same-day) day_type == chop
trades entered on a day whose OWN (same-day) day_type != chop

grid.group_A_rule: premium_stop_pct value applies ONLY to TRENDLINE-tier trades (the only trades that ever read this field); trail_pct value applies to ALL trades regardless of tier (whichever trades reach the runner stage read it). STRUCTURE-tier trades' catastrophe_stop_pct is UNCHANGED (-0.50) in every group-A cell -- this study does not re-open that knob.
grid.group_B_and_C_rule: Both knobs applied together, uniformly across BOTH tiers, ONLY to trades matching the cell's date-class rule; non-matching trades get the untouched control shape. Applied together (not isolated per-knob) because they are non-overlapping in which trade-stage they affect (premium_stop_pct only touches premium-mode pre-TP1 trades; trail_pct only touches trades that reach the post-TP1 runner stage) -- this is a single coherent 'go tighter on this day-class' or 'go wider on this day-class' policy, not two confounded experiments.

gates.convention: Standing 4-gate bar (task's explicit instruction), adapted to an EXIT-SHAPE A/B exactly per the precedent trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json already established for this exact population type (delta = candidate minus control, not a raw-PnL floor, since every cell replays the SAME 190 trades under two different exit shapes rather than filtering to a population subset).
gates.g1_positive_aggregate: sum(candidate_pnl) - sum(control_pnl) > 0 over the TUNING population only
gates.g2_day_majority: count(days where candidate day-total > control day-total) > count(days where control day-total >= candidate day-total), TUNING population only
gates.g3_survives_ex_top1: remove the single trade with the largest POSITIVE (candidate-control) delta; remaining aggregate delta still > 0, TUNING population only
gates.g4_held_out_positive: sum(candidate_pnl) - sum(control_pnl) > 0 on the SACRED held-out population, touched once, never used for cell selection
gates.evidence_floor: n_real_fills (trades actually touched by the cell's class rule, tuning-scope) >= 15 advisory per OP-16 -- flagged, not auto-disqualifying at cell level; disqualifying at the CANDIDATE level if the only cell(s) clearing all 4 gates are below floor.

significance.p_raw_convention: One-sided paired-delta test (candidate_pnl - control_pnl, mean > 0), normal-approximation t-statistic (erf-based) -- verbatim convention from trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json's `one_sided_p_mean_gt_0`, computed on the TUNING-scope per-trade deltas for each cell.
significance.portfolio_bh: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at alpha=0.10 across all 13 cells' p_raw values, computed ONCE across the full grid (matching EDGE-MATRIX-FULLHIST-2026-07-23.md's portfolio-level convention) -- reported per the task's explicit instruction to report ex_top3 and p_raw for the portfolio-level BH.

disclosures_before_run: This is a DIFFERENT axis from trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json (CONTROL_HOLDS on 113 mixed real-fills positions, blended population, uniform shape). That study is NOT re-run here; its result is cited as prior evidence the blended-population version of this knob family already failed, motivating why a CLASS-CONDITIONAL version is the legitimately new question.

This study's population (190 fullhist-replay trades, real OPRA option-bar-derived P&L) is DIFFERENT from trail-width-exit-2026-07-21.json's population (113 real broker-fill positions from fills-ledger.jsonl, 2026-06-26..2026-07-17 only) -- both are 'real OPRA fills, not BS-synthetic' by this repo's standing convention, but they are not the same trades and are not pooled together anywhere in this study.

CLASS_DAYSAME cells (C1/C2) are explicitly NON-CAUSAL and NON-DEPLOYABLE -- included as a disclosed diagnostic only, per the mandatory fidelity stack's 'levels caveat' instruction and OP-33. They will be reported with a verdict of 'not gate-eligible (non-causal)' regardless of what the 4 gates read, never as SHIP or CONTROL_HOLDS.

trendline-family-refinement-2026-07-23.json (sibling lane, same night) tests a DIFFERENT question on an overlapping population -- ENTRY-side admission conditioning (ribbon spread/structure/entry-hour gates that would exclude some TRENDLINE trades from firing at all). This study never touches entry admission; it only changes what happens to a trade AFTER it has already fired. The two lanes are complementary, not overlapping, and neither result depends on the other.

ribbon_tick_df fidelity: this study rebuilds the continuous-RTH ribbon lookup (lib.ribbon.compute_ribbon over the full 2025-01-02..2026-07-22 RTH close series) and re-derives each trade's ribbon_tick_df via the identical backward merge_asof engine_fullhist_replay.py used, specifically so ribbon_flip_back exits replay identically under CONTROL here as they did in the source replay -- verified via an exact byte-for-byte CONTROL-vs-source-replay reconciliation check before any candidate cell is scored (reported in the output, not assumed).

No live wiring, no commits, no broker imports, no params.json edits, no strategies.py edits. Output is a ranked cell table + honest-null verdict only, written to analysis/kitchen/class-conditional-exits-episodes.json.
